First option is the defensive sacrifice (-1 to enemy Wound rolls against it), second is the offensive sacrifice (+1 to its own Wound rolls); the D3 mortal-wound self-cost resolves at end of phase (timing not encoded). Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: All is Dust
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Drops the "unmodified" qualifier on the Damage 1 gate, and "any armour saving throw" is modeled as a generic save modifier (invulnerable saves are not distinguished). Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Chronosorcerous Bleed
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used at the start of the opponent's Charge phase by an unengaged Thousand Sons Psyker or Scintillating Legions unit; the selected enemy unit must be visible and within 12".

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Deceptive Glamour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Enemy models within Engagement Range of this unit can only target it if there are no eligible Scintillating Legions targets for their attacks; the forced target-priority rule is encoded as an opaque grant. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Ethereal Phantasm
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Triggered after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of an unengaged Scintillating Legions unit. The move is up to D6", or a flat 6" instead while wholly within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons units; the flat-6 upgrade is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fractal Disjunction
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Scintillating Legions units (excluding Monsters) only; the unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Glimmershift Portal
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used at the end of the opponent's Fight phase on up to two Scintillating Legions units (excluding Monsters), or one Scintillating Legions Monster unit, that are more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units; they are removed and placed into Strategic Reserves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Sulphurous Veil
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time an attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll (incoming modifier).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Cyberspirit Machinations
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Requires a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6" of the Vehicle when used.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Ensorcelled Infusion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Requires a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6"; applies to ranged weapons equipped by Vehicle models in the unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hex-Marked Armour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Worsens the Armour Penetration of incoming attacks by 1 until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Malevolent Animus
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Requires a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6" when used; modifiers to saving throws are still applied (the exclusion is not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Mutate Landscape
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The controlled objective becomes mutated: it stays under your control until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase, and while mutated each enemy unit ending a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range suffers D3 mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+; the hazard rider is encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warpflame Gargoyles
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of the Vehicle; roll six D6, one mortal wound per 5+, then that enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Arcane Focus
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after taking a Psychic test for a model that Channelled the Warp, before resolving the Ritual; re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that test, including the additional Channelling die.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Desecration of Worlds
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The objective marker the unit is in range of remains under your control until the opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Destined by Fate
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after a saving throw is failed for the Psyker model; the Damage characteristic of that attack is changed to 0. With fast dice rolling, select one of the failed saves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Egotistical Power
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Select Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium; that Kindred Sorcery ability applies to this unit instead of any other, even if it was already selected this battle.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Psychic Dominion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Attacks made against this unit with Psychic weapons gain [HAZARDOUS] (encoded as an opaque grant) and models in the unit have Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blessed Transmutations
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your Command phase on a Tzaangors unit below Starting Strength within 12" of a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker model; return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding Characters) to the unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Deranged Ferocity
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Models within 3" of enemy models are eligible to fight and can target an enemy unit within 3" of them that is within Engagement Range of their unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Gift of Change
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Used on a just-destroyed Thousand Sons Character model (excluding Monsters); at the end of the phase add one Tzeentch Chaos Spawn unit of one model to your army, set up as close as possible to where the model was destroyed and outside Engagement Range.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Touched by Tzeentch
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced (one of the two, chosen when acting).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Twisted Mirage
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The unit arriving from Strategic Reserves can be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (more than 8" for a Monster unit); it is not eligible to charge this turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Implacable Guardians
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time an attack is allocated to a model in the unit (excluding Psyker models), subtract 1 from its Damage characteristic; the Psyker-model exclusion is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Infernal Fusillade
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in the unit; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Revenge of the Rubricae
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after a Thousand Sons Psyker model is destroyed within 6" of the unit; after the attacking unit has shot, this unit can shoot, but may only target the enemy unit that destroyed the Psyker (if eligible).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Unwavering Phalanx
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range; each time an attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll (incoming modifier).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Embroiling Energies
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to the unit's malefic curse weapon; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Spell-warded Armour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Ranged attacks targeting this unit with a Strength greater than the unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Nethershriek Mind-Eater
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Thousand Sons or Lord of Change model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, one visible enemy unit within 12" takes a Battle-shock test; if failed, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Diabolic Savant
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly Scintillating Legions units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp; the proximity gate is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Duplicitous Malediction
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Thousand Sons or Lord of Change model only. After deployment, redeploy up to three Thousand Sons units; they can be placed into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp Syphon
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] While within 6" of a friendly Thousand Sons Vehicle unit, after rolling the additional Channelling die but before checking doubles or triples, the bearer may have a selected Vehicle unit suffer 1 mortal wound to re-roll that die; encoded as an opaque grant. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Perplexing Cloak
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies while the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons Vehicle units; the proximity gate is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Biomechanical Mutation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Command phase, one friendly Thousand Sons Vehicle model within 6" regains up to D3 lost wounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp-Cursed Runemaster
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons Vehicle units; the proximity gate is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Incandaeum
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Once per battle, when selecting a Ritual for the bearer, Doombolt can be selected even if a model from your army has already attempted to manifest it this phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Umbralefic Crystal
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is unengaged: place it into Strategic Reserves; it has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase and must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including on your first turn).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warpmeld Dagger
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] When attempting a Ritual, just before determining the Psychic test result, the bearer can suffer D3 mortal wounds; if not destroyed, add 1 to the test result for each mortal wound suffered. Encoded as an opaque grant. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Diamond of Distortion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll (incoming modifier).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bray Lord
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Sorcerer or Infernal Master model only; the bearer has the Scouts 6" ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Risen Rubricae
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select either two Rubricae Battleline units or one other Rubricae unit from your army; models in the selected units gain the Infiltrators ability. Encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Lord of the Rubricae
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by Rubricae models in that unit; the per-model Rubricae scoping is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Foresight of the Changer
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In the opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of the bearer's unengaged unit, that unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp-tainted Shells
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to the bearer's infernal cannon; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.
